decks.module: New applicants and the initial evidence checklist

cards.front: Complete the rule: Idaho treats a person who has never held…
cards.back: Idaho treats a person who has never held a license in any jurisdiction as a new applicant.
cards.memory_hook: New applicants and the initial evidence

cards.front: Complete the rule: A person returning to Idaho after obtaining…
cards.back: A person returning to Idaho after obtaining a credential elsewhere is considered a new applicant.
cards.memory_hook: New applicants and the initial evidence

cards.front: Complete the rule: A person surrendering another jurisdiction’s license…
cards.back: A person surrendering another jurisdiction’s license is treated as a new applicant.
cards.memory_hook: New applicants and the initial evidence

cards.front: Complete the rule: An Idaho license that expired twenty-five months or…
cards.back: An Idaho license that expired twenty-five months or more earlier puts the holder in the new-applicant category.
cards.memory_hook: New applicants and the initial evidence

cards.front: Complete the rule: A new credential application requires…
cards.back: A new credential application requires evidence of age and identity.
cards.memory_hook: New applicants and the initial evidence

cards.front: Complete the rule: A new credential application requires verification…
cards.back: A new credential application requires verification of a Social Security card or number.
cards.memory_hook: New applicants and the initial evidence

cards.front: Complete the rule: A new credential application…
cards.back: A new credential application requires evidence of Idaho residency.
cards.memory_hook: New applicants and the initial evidence

cards.front: Complete the rule: Where applicable, a new…
cards.back: Where applicable, a new credential application requires lawful-presence documents.
cards.memory_hook: New applicants and the initial evidence

cards.front: Complete the rule: A new applicant may need visual or…
cards.back: A new applicant may need visual or medical certification when it applies to the applicant.
cards.memory_hook: New applicants and the initial evidence

cards.front: Complete the rule: Applicants younger than seventeen must…
cards.back: Applicants younger than seventeen must provide driver training completion evidence.
cards.memory_hook: New applicants and the initial evidence

cards.front: Complete the rule: Applicants younger than eighteen…
cards.back: Applicants younger than eighteen need a liability signer.
cards.memory_hook: New applicants and the initial evidence

cards.front: Complete the rule: Applicants younger than eighteen…
cards.back: Applicants younger than eighteen must supply school-compliance verification.
cards.memory_hook: New applicants and the initial evidence

cards.front: Complete the rule: The county office must verify age and…
cards.back: The county office must verify age and identity before issuing a license or identification card.
cards.memory_hook: New applicants and the initial evidence

decks.module: Photo identity, accepted documents and name connections

cards.front: Complete the rule: Surrendering a state photo credential together with a…
cards.back: Surrendering a state photo credential together with a United States birth certificate showing the full legal name and birth date is sufficient age-and-identity evidence.
cards.memory_hook: Photo identity accepted documents and name

cards.front: Complete the rule: The age-and-identity documents described in the handbook…
cards.back: The age-and-identity documents described in the handbook cannot be submitted as photocopies or faxes.
cards.memory_hook: Photo identity accepted documents and name

cards.front: Complete the rule: A driver privilege card does…
cards.back: A driver privilege card does not qualify as age-and-identity evidence.
cards.memory_hook: Photo identity accepted documents and name

cards.front: Complete the rule: An other-state license or identification card needs a…
cards.back: An other-state license or identification card needs a United States birth certificate or equivalent to serve as identity evidence in Idaho.
cards.memory_hook: Photo identity accepted documents and name

cards.front: Complete the rule: An applicant younger than eighteen does not…
cards.back: An applicant younger than eighteen does not have to possess a photo identification card.
cards.memory_hook: Photo identity accepted documents and name

cards.front: Complete the rule: A minor without photo identification may use a…
cards.back: A minor without photo identification may use a parent’s or guardian’s photo identification with the child’s certified original birth certificate and any necessary guardianship evidence.
cards.memory_hook: Photo identity accepted documents and name

cards.front: Complete the rule: When a minor presents an accepted photo identification…
cards.back: When a minor presents an accepted photo identification document, extra parental or guardian identification is unnecessary.
cards.memory_hook: Photo identity accepted documents and name

cards.front: Complete the rule: A birth certificate submitted for identity proof must…
cards.back: A birth certificate submitted for identity proof must be accompanied by an accepted photo identity document.
cards.memory_hook: Photo identity accepted documents and name

cards.front: Complete the rule: When a birth certificate name differs from the…
cards.back: When a birth certificate name differs from the current name, a secondary document must connect the names.
cards.memory_hook: Photo identity accepted documents and name

cards.front: Complete the rule: A certified marriage certificate or court-ordered name-change documentation…
cards.back: A certified marriage certificate or court-ordered name-change documentation can link the birth name with the current legal name.
cards.memory_hook: Photo identity accepted documents and name

cards.front: Complete the rule: An Idaho photo license or identification card expired…
cards.back: An Idaho photo license or identification card expired less than five years is listed as acceptable photo identity evidence.
cards.memory_hook: Photo identity accepted documents and name

cards.front: Complete the rule: An other-state photo license or identification card expired…
cards.back: An other-state photo license or identification card expired less than five years is listed as acceptable photo identity evidence.
cards.memory_hook: Photo identity accepted documents and name

cards.front: Complete the rule: An acceptable valid Homeland Security photo…
cards.back: An acceptable valid Homeland Security photo document is listed as photo identity evidence.
cards.memory_hook: Photo identity accepted documents and name

cards.front: Complete the rule: United States military identification, including retired-military and military-dependent…
cards.back: United States military identification, including retired-military and military-dependent cards, is listed among accepted photo identity documents.
cards.memory_hook: Photo identity accepted documents and name

cards.front: Complete the rule: A valid United States passport or passport…
cards.back: A valid United States passport or passport card is listed as acceptable photo identity evidence.
cards.memory_hook: Photo identity accepted documents and name

cards.front: Complete the rule: An original citizenship or naturalization document…
cards.back: An original citizenship or naturalization document is listed among photo identity documents.
cards.memory_hook: Photo identity accepted documents and name

cards.front: Complete the rule: A foreign passport is listed…
cards.back: A foreign passport is listed among the accepted identity documents.
cards.memory_hook: Photo identity accepted documents and name

cards.front: Complete the rule: An Idaho concealed-weapons permit expired no more than…
cards.back: An Idaho concealed-weapons permit expired no more than one year is listed among the photo identity documents.
cards.memory_hook: Photo identity accepted documents and name

cards.front: Complete the rule: A veteran Universal Access Card carrying a…
cards.back: A veteran Universal Access Card carrying a photograph is listed as photo identity evidence.
cards.memory_hook: Photo identity accepted documents and name

cards.front: Complete the rule: A Native American identification card with a…
cards.back: A Native American identification card with a photograph is listed as photo identity evidence.
cards.memory_hook: Photo identity accepted documents and name

cards.front: Complete the rule: A Transportation Workers Identity Credential…
cards.back: A Transportation Workers Identity Credential is listed as photo identity evidence.
cards.memory_hook: Photo identity accepted documents and name

cards.front: Complete the rule: A junior or senior high school photo card…
cards.back: A junior or senior high school photo card is listed as acceptable photo identity evidence, but a college or university photo card is excluded from that example.
cards.memory_hook: Photo identity accepted documents and name

cards.front: Complete the rule: A junior high, senior high, college, university or…
cards.back: A junior high, senior high, college, university or military annual yearbook is listed among identity evidence.
cards.memory_hook: Photo identity accepted documents and name

cards.front: Complete the rule: Photo identification from Idaho Corrections or Juvenile…
cards.back: Photo identification from Idaho Corrections or Juvenile Corrections is listed among the accepted identity documents.
cards.memory_hook: Photo identity accepted documents and name

cards.front: Complete the rule: A foreign national may use a valid foreign…
cards.back: A foreign national may use a valid foreign passport instead of the certified United States birth certificate for identity documentation.
cards.memory_hook: Foreign national and secondary identity evidence

cards.front: Complete the rule: For a foreign national’s identity, the handbook requires…
cards.back: For a foreign national’s identity, the handbook requires a valid foreign passport and acceptable lawful-presence evidence.
cards.memory_hook: Foreign national and secondary identity evidence

cards.front: Complete the rule: Secondary identity documents cannot…
cards.back: Secondary identity documents cannot establish identity on their own.
cards.memory_hook: Foreign national and secondary identity evidence

cards.front: Complete the rule: A secondary identity document must show the name…
cards.back: A secondary identity document must show the name and enough information to support part or all of the primary identity evidence.
cards.memory_hook: Foreign national and secondary identity evidence

cards.front: Complete the rule: A certified court name-change record is…
cards.back: A certified court name-change record is listed as a secondary identity document.
cards.memory_hook: Foreign national and secondary identity evidence

cards.front: Complete the rule: A certified marriage record meeting Idaho standards needs…
cards.back: A certified marriage record meeting Idaho standards needs the seal and recorded document number to serve as the listed secondary evidence.
cards.memory_hook: Foreign national and secondary identity evidence

cards.front: Complete the rule: A certified divorce record from a court or…
cards.back: A certified divorce record from a court or state vital-records office is listed as secondary identity evidence.
cards.memory_hook: Foreign national and secondary identity evidence

cards.front: Complete the rule: Guardianship or custody records must be notarized or…
cards.back: Guardianship or custody records must be notarized or court-certified to qualify as the listed secondary evidence.
cards.memory_hook: Foreign national and secondary identity evidence

cards.front: Complete the rule: United States military discharge paper form…
cards.back: United States military discharge paper form DD214 is listed as secondary identity evidence.
cards.memory_hook: Foreign national and secondary identity evidence

cards.front: Complete the rule: Every submitted document must be acceptable to…
cards.back: Every submitted document must be acceptable to both ITD and the county driver’s license office.
cards.memory_hook: Foreign national and secondary identity evidence

decks.module: Social Security, residency and lawful-stay evidence

cards.front: Complete the rule: The Social Security Administration’s online verification system…
cards.back: The Social Security Administration’s online verification system must verify the applicant’s Social Security number.
cards.memory_hook: Social Security residency and lawful stay

cards.front: Complete the rule: An Idaho license or identification card does…
cards.back: An Idaho license or identification card does not display the holder’s Social Security number.
cards.memory_hook: Social Security residency and lawful stay

cards.front: Complete the rule: An applicant must live within Idaho to…
cards.back: An applicant must live within Idaho to receive an Idaho license or identification card.
cards.memory_hook: Social Security residency and lawful stay

cards.front: Complete the rule: Residency evidence must show a physical address and…
cards.back: Residency evidence must show a physical address and may include a lease, utility bill, employment record or school-enrollment record.
cards.memory_hook: Social Security residency and lawful stay

cards.front: Complete the rule: The documents used as Idaho residency…
cards.back: The documents used as Idaho residency evidence must be dated within one year.
cards.memory_hook: Social Security residency and lawful stay

cards.front: Complete the rule: A person without lawful presence in the United…
cards.back: A person without lawful presence in the United States is ineligible for an Idaho license or identification card.
cards.memory_hook: Social Security residency and lawful stay

cards.front: Complete the rule: An issuance or renewal may require lawful-presence evidence…
cards.back: An issuance or renewal may require lawful-presence evidence when citizenship proof was never provided or ITD has no record of it.
cards.memory_hook: Social Security residency and lawful stay

cards.front: Complete the rule: Listed lawful-presence evidence includes an original certified United…
cards.back: Listed lawful-presence evidence includes an original certified United States birth certificate, a valid United States passport or passport card, a birth-abroad certificate or an original naturalization or citizenship certificate.
cards.memory_hook: Social Security residency and lawful stay

cards.front: Complete the rule: A permanent resident card, resident-alien card or…
cards.back: A permanent resident card, resident-alien card or employment authorization card is listed among lawful-presence evidence.
cards.memory_hook: Social Security residency and lawful stay

cards.front: Complete the rule: A valid foreign passport together with the…
cards.back: A valid foreign passport together with the I-ninety-four arrival-departure record is listed as lawful-presence evidence.
cards.memory_hook: Social Security residency and lawful stay

cards.front: Complete the rule: For someone who is neither a citizen nor…
cards.back: For someone who is neither a citizen nor permanent legal resident, license validity ends at the documented lawful-stay end date or after four years, whichever comes first.
cards.memory_hook: Social Security residency and lawful stay

cards.front: Complete the rule: When Homeland Security documents have no expiration date…
cards.back: When Homeland Security documents have no expiration date, the license for a noncitizen who is not a permanent legal resident expires one year after issuance.
cards.memory_hook: Social Security residency and lawful stay

decks.module: Health evidence, minor consent and school compliance

cards.front: Complete the rule: A visual or medical condition affecting driving may…
cards.back: A visual or medical condition affecting driving may require a physician’s statement that the applicant can drive safely.
cards.memory_hook: Health evidence minor consent and school

cards.front: Complete the rule: After eye surgery improves vision, a physician's note…
cards.back: After eye surgery improves vision, a physician's note may support removal of the vision-related license restriction.
cards.memory_hook: Health evidence minor consent and school

cards.front: Complete the rule: An applicant younger than seventeen must document both…
cards.back: An applicant younger than seventeen must document both approved driver training completion and completion of supervised instruction requirements.
cards.memory_hook: Health evidence minor consent and school

cards.front: Complete the rule: A license applicant younger than eighteen needs parental…
cards.back: A license applicant younger than eighteen needs parental or legal-guardian consent, or may use a spouse aged at least eighteen if married, and the signer takes legal responsibility for the applicant's driving.
cards.memory_hook: Health evidence minor consent and school

cards.front: Complete the rule: A liability signer other than a birth-certificate…
cards.back: A liability signer other than a birth-certificate parent must document legal authority to consent.
cards.memory_hook: Health evidence minor consent and school

cards.front: Complete the rule: The liability signer’s…
cards.back: The liability signer’s identity must be verified.
cards.memory_hook: Health evidence minor consent and school

cards.front: Complete the rule: A signer whose name differs from the birth-certificate…
cards.back: A signer whose name differs from the birth-certificate name may need additional documents establishing the relationship.
cards.memory_hook: Health evidence minor consent and school

cards.front: Complete the rule: An absent liability signer must give another…
cards.back: An absent liability signer must give another person signing authority through a power-of-attorney form.
cards.memory_hook: Health evidence minor consent and school

cards.front: Complete the rule: Before the applicant turns eighteen, the liability signer…
cards.back: Before the applicant turns eighteen, the liability signer can withdraw consent at any time and the department will cancel the driving credential.
cards.memory_hook: Health evidence minor consent and school

cards.front: Complete the rule: A married applicant’s spouse may act as liability…
cards.back: A married applicant’s spouse may act as liability signer if the spouse is at least eighteen.
cards.memory_hook: Health evidence minor consent and school

cards.front: Complete the rule: An applicant younger than eighteen must show acceptable…
cards.back: An applicant younger than eighteen must show acceptable evidence of attendance and enrollment in, or graduation from, a recognized high school or equivalent program.
cards.memory_hook: Health evidence minor consent and school

cards.front: Complete the rule: School compliance may be documented by a verification…
cards.back: School compliance may be documented by a verification slip from an acceptable school or program the applicant attends, a high school diploma or a general-education completion certificate.
cards.memory_hook: Health evidence minor consent and school

cards.front: Complete the rule: The parent or guardian signing liability consent…
cards.back: The parent or guardian signing liability consent must also affirm compliance with Idaho’s school-attendance provisions.
cards.memory_hook: Health evidence minor consent and school

decks.module: Star Card documentation and optional designations

cards.front: Complete the rule: A Star Card application needs…
cards.back: A Star Card application needs identity, photograph and lawful-presence evidence.
cards.memory_hook: Star Card documentation and optional designations

cards.front: Complete the rule: A Star Card applicant needs name-change…
cards.back: A Star Card applicant needs name-change evidence when the legal name has changed.
cards.memory_hook: Star Card documentation and optional designations

cards.front: Complete the rule: A Star Card applicant’s Social Security number…
cards.back: A Star Card applicant’s Social Security number is verified with the Social Security Administration.
cards.memory_hook: Star Card documentation and optional designations

cards.front: Complete the rule: A Star Card application requires two…
cards.back: A Star Card application requires two proofs showing an Idaho physical residence address.
cards.memory_hook: Star Card documentation and optional designations

cards.front: Complete the rule: The donor designation may be…
cards.back: The donor designation may be requested beginning at age fifteen.
cards.memory_hook: Star Card documentation and optional designations

cards.front: Complete the rule: A donor designation communicates the holder’s wish…
cards.back: A donor designation communicates the holder’s wish to donate organs or tissue after death.
cards.memory_hook: Star Card documentation and optional designations

cards.front: Complete the rule: A donor applicant younger than eighteen needs…
cards.back: A donor applicant younger than eighteen needs consent from a parent or adult guardian.
cards.memory_hook: Star Card documentation and optional designations

cards.front: Complete the rule: For a veteran designation, the handbook specifies form…
cards.back: For a veteran designation, the handbook specifies form DD214 showing honorable discharge and refers applicants to ITD's list for other acceptable documents.
cards.memory_hook: Star Card documentation and optional designations
